item.title: My Personal Hubs Instance: A Dedicated XR Space
item.description: I have set up a personal instance of Mozilla Hubs to explore and demonstrate the capabilities of this versatile VR platform 🥽. This dedicated space allows for a more controlled environment to showcase and experiment with features for socializing, collaboration, and immersive experiences 🌌. Key Features and Benefits 🔑: Browser-Native Access: Easily join and interact within 3D environments directly from your web browser, requiring no additional software 🌐. Customizable Presence: Utilize personalized avatars to represent yourself in the virtual space 👤.

item.title: Behavioral Graphs: Enhancing XR Interaction
item.description: Behavioral Graphs (BGs) represent an innovative extension to platforms like Mozilla Hubs, designed to enrich XR environments with interactive features 📊. We believe BGs offer a significant advancement beyond traditional “gallery-like” scenes, pushing the boundaries of user engagement in virtual spaces 🌌. What are Behavioral Graphs? 🧠 Behavioral Graphs are dynamic, data-driven systems that analyze and respond to user actions within XR environments. They enable more personalized and interactive experiences by modeling user behavior and providing context-aware assistance or content 🤖.

item.title: Mozilla Hubs XR Experiments: Enhancing Educational Spaces
item.description: This section details experiments with Mozilla Hubs, exploring its application in university teaching and creating immersive learning environments 🎓. Our goal is to represent complex subjects, like the periodic table, as interactive networks of virtual spaces 🕸️. Project Overview: The Periodic Table in VR 🧪 We are developing virtual environments where each element has its own dedicated space, enriched with relevant information. For example, nitrogen’s space could illustrate the formation of nitrogen oxides in car traffic or its role in fertilizer production 💨.

item.title: Running 'Hello WebXR' Instance
item.description: The official WebXR Demo Instance is down 🛑. Luckily, I host a private version of it: https://tobias-weiss.org/hello-webxr/ 🌐 Please use the right controller and the trigger button (index finger) to navigate 🎮.
